webster.text: Not feigned; not counterfeit; not hypocritical; real; sincere; as unfeigned piety to God; unfeigned love to man.

example.quote: There can be no true religion, till there be a discovery of your lost state by nature and practice, and an unfeigned acceptance of Christ Jesus, as he is offered in the gospel.
example.cite: John Witherspoon, The Dominion of Providence over the Passions of Men (preached at Princeton May 17, 1776; Glasgow reprint 1777)
